welcome.title: Welcome, explorer!
welcome.text: 5 puzzles await you on the path. Solve them one by one to fill the gauge at the bottom of the screen and unlock the final treasure. Tap a card to start a puzzle.

error.title: Error
error.text: That's not the correct answer. Try again!

game1.title: Game 1 - Augmented Reality
game1.subtitle: Scan the target
game1.instructions: Point the camera at the printed target to reveal the clue.
game1.correct: Well done! You solved the puzzle.

game2.title: Game 2 - NFC/QR Code
game2.subtitle: Scan the code to continue
game2.instructions: Bring your device close to the NFC tag or scan the QR code.
game2.qrModalInstructions: Point the camera at the QR code.
game2.qrError: Invalid QR Code. Try another code.

game3.title: Game 3 - Image Search
game3.subtitle: Find the hidden detail
game3.question: What is the name of this furniture?
game3.correct: Well done! That's the correct answer.
game3.incorrect: That's not the right name. Try again.

game4.title: Game 4 - Riddle
game4.subtitle: Solve the riddle
game4.question: I am an 18th-century furniture, who am I?
game4.hint: I am usually made of wood and have drawers.

game5.title: Game 5 - Quiz
game5.subtitle: Choose the correct answer
game5.question: Who is the designer of this furniture?

success.title: Well Done!
success.subtitle: You solved all 5 puzzles!
success.message: Congratulations! You have completed all the puzzles of the treasure hunt.
success.formMessage: You will be redirected to a form to participate in the draw and win a book on design.

misc.childHelp: Children can be helped by an adult.
